title: Implement scoped comments and reactions
verify: Authorized accounts can create at most one editable field comment with author/time attribution.
Each supported object accepts one of five reactions and exposes permitted reactors without cross-context leakage.
evidence_required: FT-004-AC-001 RED: an account can create multiple editable field comments or attribution/time is missing; GREEN: one account has at most one editable comment per field and permitted viewers see author/last-change time; artifact: .tasks/TASK-011-T3-FT-004-W5/ and .protocols/TASK-011-T3-FT-004-W5/verification.md.

FT-004-AC-002 RED: unsupported reaction, duplicate reaction, or reactor visibility is incorrect; GREEN: one of five standard reactions is applied to each supported object and permitted viewers see its reactors; artifact: .tasks/TASK-011-T3-FT-004-W5/ and .protocols/TASK-011-T3-FT-004-W5/verification.md.

FT-004-AC-005 RED: shared/personal discussion objects are readable or mutable outside selected role/student scope; GREEN: only permitted discussion objects are visible and mutable; artifact: .tasks/TASK-011-T3-FT-004-W5/ and .protocols/TASK-011-T3-FT-004-W5/verification.md.
purpose: Establish Collaboration object ownership and shared/personal scope enforcement.
success_outcome: Comments and reactions are attributable, bounded to permitted day/student scope, and impossible to mutate through a neighboring slice or guessed context.
anti_goals: Do not create a second discussion store in Lesson Context.
Do not treat hidden discussion branches as deleted.
constraints: Collaboration exclusively writes comments and reactions.
Actor and class/student scope are resolved server-side.
invariants: One account owns at most one editable comment per field.
Shared and personal discussion visibility never crosses scope.
verification_targets: FT-004-AC-001: account/field uniqueness, edit ownership, author and last-change attribution scenario.
FT-004-AC-002: five-reaction interaction for fields/comments/messages with permitted-reactor projection.
FT-004-AC-005: shared/personal and cross-student negative authorization scenarios for read and mutation.

stop_conditions: Stop if collaboration needs an event bus or new privacy boundary.
